review:
A 5x3 joker game with lutes, juggling pins and jesters paying up to 1,000x in the base game, plus a pick-to-match jackpot bonus.

Three to five bonus symbols trigger it, and a prize is certain: 18 coins appear and you reveal Mini, Minor, Major, Maxi, Mega or Grand symbols until three match, winning that jackpot – up to 5,000x. Simple, with a satisfying reveal. 96.51% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
